findings.title: Playlist load errors swallowed; empty playlist marked as saved
findings.impact: e.status is undefined on AuthFetchError (status is on e.response.status); 403/5xx shows an empty playlist with no alert, marked saved; a later save may overwrite the real day with an empty playlist

findings.title: Any token-refresh failure (incl. 5xx/network) logs out all tabs
findings.impact: Backend restart/self-update overlapping a refresh drops operator sessions in every tab

findings.title: Modal dialogs lack focus move/trap/restore; Schedule/Live dialogs ignore Escape (WCAG 2.4.3, 2.1.1)
findings.impact: Keyboard users can tab into background controls while a modal is open; focus lost on close

findings.title: <html lang> fixed to 'en' regardless of locale (WCAG 3.1.1)
findings.impact: Screen readers use English pronunciation for pt-BR/de/ru UI

findings.title: Destructive buttons hard-code #ff9da0 text: ~2:1 contrast in light theme
findings.impact: Delete actions are least legible controls in light mode (WCAG 1.4.3 failure)

findings.title: SCTE-35 error and config warning share style; error dot same red as on-air
findings.impact: Operators cannot distinguish error vs warning vs on-air at a glance

findings.title: obtainUuid 401 check never fires; failed uuid fetch leaves SSE status stream dead
findings.impact: Live on-air/playout status can go stale until next configInit

findings.title: Channel-list failure falls back to fabricated 'Channel 1'
findings.impact: Operator may act on a channel id not provided by the server

findings.title: Chunked upload: sibling workers not aborted on chunk failure; retry can race same batch
findings.impact: Orphan chunk requests; possible concurrent writers to same media file

findings.title: Concurrent playlist loads unguarded; stale response overwrites state and save snapshot
findings.impact: Fast date/channel switching can make dirty/save target wrong day

findings.title: Media browse store applies stale responses; isLoading reset by first finisher
findings.impact: Late response from previous folder/channel overwrites current view

findings.title: msgAlert overlapping timers hide newer alerts early
findings.impact: Error alerts can vanish after ~1s before being read

findings.title: de-DE/ru-RU ~1561 keys missing; pt-BR missing a few keys and has orphan keys
findings.impact: Mixed-language UI for de/ru operators

findings.title: No unsaved-changes guard on in-app route navigation
findings.impact: Unsaved playlist/settings edits may be lost when navigating via menu (actual loss NOT_VERIFIED)

findings.title: On-air state changes not in live region; error alerts time out in 3-4s (WCAG 4.1.3)
findings.impact: Screen-reader operators not told when playout starts/stops/resyncs

findings.title: Login password label wraps show/hide button; compound accessible name
findings.impact: Field announced as 'Password Show password'; ambiguous toggle state

findings.title: Logging error-count pill styled identically to ON AIR badge
findings.impact: Error count reads as on-air state

findings.title: Live protocol selection #1c1c1c on --live ~3.15:1 in light; timeline live colour differs
findings.impact: Contrast failure and inconsistent 'live' colour

findings.title: On-air/warning colours bypass theme tokens (two reds, yellow vs orange)
findings.impact: Same state renders differently across screens

findings.title: Playlist table min-w 760px; actions off-screen on narrow viewports
findings.impact: On-air playlist controls need horizontal scroll on phones (layout NOT_VERIFIED)

findings.title: Arbitrary text sizes; on-air marker at 10px below --text-xs floor
findings.impact: Critical status among smallest text

findings.title: authFetchRaw returns second 401 after refresh without ending session
findings.impact: Revoked users see repeated toasts instead of login redirect

findings.title: Tokens in localStorage/BroadcastChannel; SSE uuid and access token in URL query
findings.impact: XSS would enable token theft; time-limited log leakage (server IP-binds tokens)

findings.title: uploadPhoto bypasses authFetch (no refresh/retry); unguarded JSON.parse
findings.impact: Long photo uploads fail with raw error

findings.title: Updates poller interval never stopped
findings.impact: Small bounded no-op polling after logout

findings.title: App.vue global listeners never removed; theme localStorage read without try/catch
findings.impact: HMR duplication; setup can throw if storage unavailable

findings.title: 'any' on config payloads and auth responses
findings.impact: Shape changes not caught at compile time

findings.title: No catch-all route
findings.impact: Mistyped/stale URLs likely render blank (NOT_VERIFIED)

findings.title: Role gating only on /configure; operator views ungated client-side
findings.impact: UI shows operator views to 'user' role; server enforcement not confirmed here

findings.title: Setup redirect check only on home and fails open
findings.impact: Fresh install opened at /player bypasses /init redirect

findings.title: UserEditor password-mismatch error not linked to fields
findings.impact: Error not associated with fields; placeholder-only instruction
